name: TOWN Civic Surface Foundation V1
description: Canonical V1 contract for the reusable civic surface: signals, confirmations, submissions, discussions, audit trails, and RBAC planes. Complements membership-foundation.v1.json, billing-foundation.v1.json, account-identity-contract.v1.json, and authentication-ceremony-foundation.v1.json. Live HTTP shapes are authoritative in docs/openapi.v1.json.
authorityOrder: Runtime code under src/ (evaluateCivicAccess, routes, schema checks)
docs/openapi.v1.json for live HTTP request/response shapes
This contract for civic-surface domain invariants and reuse boundaries
Sibling foundation contracts for membership, billing, identity, ceremony
README narrative (non-authoritative when it conflicts with the above)

repos.town-api: Authoritative backend for all civic-surface tables, routes, and RBAC
repos.town-public: Web consumer of the civic surface; never invents membership, confirmation, or participate authority
repos.town-safe-space-mobile: Outside the current web-launch critical path

domainSeparation.accountIdentity: accounts, verified email, passkeys — active account does not imply paid membership or civic participation
domainSeparation.authenticatedSession: Opaque account_sessions (web cookie or Authorization: Session) — not membership and not civic entitlement
domainSeparation.membershipEntitlement: town.membership_entitlements + source-event ledger — payment/access window only
domainSeparation.civicActor: town.actors — local civic identity linked 1:1 to an account when present; confirmations and contributions attach to actors
domainSeparation.communityOwner: accounts.is_owner — community moderation/payment bypass for the same participant level only; never platform access
domainSeparation.platformOperator: town.platform_operators — separate privilege plane with ranked roles/capabilities; never implied by is_owner
domainSeparation.controlledTestActor: Temporary testing-only actor + X-TOWN-Control-Key confirmation GET; never linked to a real account

seedPolicy: Fixed UUIDs only; seed never calls random UUID generators or Date.now()
Seeds never run at application startup
Foundation seed yields exactly 3 communities and 9 published signals
Controlled-actor seed yields exactly one Milano controlled_test actor and zero confirmation rows

runtimeDerivation: visitor when no session is present
read_only when a session is present but participant preconditions are not all met

participant only when the account is active AND (accounts.is_owner OR temporally valid entitlement status active|cancelling) AND a linked civic actor exists for the request community AND a valid community commitment is recorded
technical local eligibility / GPS verification is NOT a V1 participation gate (reported field only; LOCAL_ELIGIBILITY_ENABLED defaults false → unavailable)
denialPolicy: Public responses never leak the specific denialReason
Bounded denialReason is recorded only in identity_security_events.civic_participation_denied metadata
Clients must never interpret a community-mismatch 403 as missing membership when membership truth already says paid/civic

signals.memberAuthorPair: author_actor_id and author_account_id are both null (editorial) or both set (member-authored)

auth.memberPublish: active Session + evaluateCivicAccess.canParticipate for the path community; SetupGrant/RecoveryGrant/Bearer rejected

responsePolicy: Never expose actor or account identifiers on public civic DTOs
authorDisplayName is civic display_label / editorial metadata only
List/detail may include confirmationCount as an integer aggregate only
Image storage is imageKey + focus coordinates / private object storage — no public CDN URLs in foundation rows

confirmations.semantics: Idempotent actor↔signal confirmation (I SEE THIS TOO); no revoke route in V1

auth.put: participant Session only; control key rejected; CSRF for web mutative
auth.get: participant Session OR temporary X-TOWN-Control-Key controlled-actor path

submissions.distinction: Pending-review queue path — distinct from immediate member publish POST .../signals
submissions.auth: participant Session + CSRF for create; platform operator capabilities for moderation
submissions.reuse: stable schema; product path flag-gated off by default

discussions.semantics: One session per published signal; solution-oriented contributions — not chat, comments, or social threading
discussions.auth: active Session + canParticipate; denials → 403 CIVIC_PARTICIPATION_NOT_AUTHORIZED + civic_participation_denied
responsePolicy: authorDisplayName only — never account or actor identifiers
Hidden contributions (hidden_at IS NOT NULL) are filtered from participant reads
Media lives in private object storage

identitySecurityEvents.purpose: Account-scoped security, ceremony, membership, and civic-denial events
metadataPolicy: Never raw session tokens, cookies, or Authorization headers

platformAuditEvents.purpose: Operator actions with first-class operator identity — separate from identity_security_events

grants: Same participant civic level without paid entitlement (session/actor/commitment still required)
Owner moderation routes for signals/accounts in community scope

platformOperator.authFailure: generic 404 fail-closed — never advertise the platform plane

sessionAndGrants.session: Normal APIs, civic participation, membership self-read, platform

townPublicConsumerRules.home: After login with recorded community commitment, HOME shows the member community first
townPublicConsumerRules.exploreZone: Other-city signals appear only after a dedicated explore divider; participation remains local
townPublicConsumerRules.exploreCopy: Poți explora, dar participarea este rezervată comunității locale.
townPublicConsumerRules.membershipInvite: Visitor membership invite only when shouldOfferMembershipInvite is true — never for paid, paid_pending_binding, or civic-capable accounts
townPublicConsumerRules.communityMismatch403: Never interpret as missing membership when authoritative membership/civic truth already exists

flagGatedOrTemporary: LOCAL_ELIGIBILITY_ENABLED (default false; not a V1 participation gate)
GOOGLE_PLAY_BILLING_ENABLED (default false; outside web-launch critical path)
explicitExclusions: Flutter / native app-store launch as current critical path
Chat product surface (town-public CHAT is honest unavailable)
Client-side simulated membership or participate unlocks
Redis as a required runtime dependency
